Long deconv division and executed diff/trapz arithmetic do not preserve imaginary parts, but cloned passthrough branches do. Callback retry excludes exactly-once effects. Warning gates and fzero success flag1 do not exclude nonzero residual results.

obernants.operator: Fixed-N Fourier outputs identify padded/truncated slices up to rounding, leaving arbitrary truncated tails. Poly quotient/remainder plus real divisor reconstructs dividend via padded convolution; short dividends clone remainder. Least-squares B lies in AX plus residual orthogonal to retained columns. Sort values plus permutation recover slices; sums have zero-sum fibers. fzero output is compatible with bracket-width stopping or1000-iteration exhaustion and nonzero residual, even discontinuous functions without a root; only sampled fb==0 establishes an observed zero.
